title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to prevent users from uploading duplicate files as attachments (Duplicate file names)
summary: Preventing duplicate file attachments in Business Central requires customization because the standard allows the same file to be uploaded multiple times. The post demonstrates a solution using a table extension to add a setting and an event subscriber to block duplicate file names based on configuration.
key_points: Standard Business Central allows uploading duplicate files with the same name to attachments
The AllowDuplicateFileName variable in table 1173 Document Attachment controls this behavior but has no UI setting
No standard event forces this value, so customization is needed
Solution uses a table extension to General Ledger Setup plus an event subscriber on OnInsertAttachmentOnBeforeImportStream

quotes.text: In the standard Business Central, it is allowed to upload the same file multiple times, which means duplicate files.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core problem that needs to be solved

quotes.text: There is no Allow Duplicate FileName setting in the BC, and there is no event to force the value of this variable.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why standard configuration alone cannot solve this problem

quotes.text: So this can't be done in the standard, and requires some simple customization.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that a code-based solution is necessary
